claims.text: Existing approaches for uncertainty estimation in LLMs are either white-box or computationally demanding.
The proposed non-parametric uncertainty quantification method estimates point-wise dependencies between input and decision on the fly with a single inference.
The proposed uncertainty quantification estimator operates without access to token logits.
The proposed decision-making agent asks users to provide preferences when more than one action has high estimated point-wise dependencies.
The proposed uncertainty estimation and decision-making agent design offer a cost-efficient approach for AI agent development.

evidence.description: Existing approaches are either white-box or computationally demanding, limiting use of black-box proprietary LLMs within budgets.
